# Trusted Tech Leader

> AI consultancy for businesses that want results: AI strategy and consulting, AI automation and agents, custom business systems (CRM, billing, operations), and web and mobile apps.

## Services
- [AI automation](https://trustedtechleader.com/ai-automation/): AI added where it removes repetitive work: drafting, reading, matching and routing, with a person reviewing before it is published.
- [Custom business systems](https://trustedtechleader.com/business-systems/): Custom CRM, billing, inventory and reporting built as one system around how your business runs, not around a template.
- [Web and mobile apps](https://trustedtechleader.com/web-and-mobile-apps/): Customer-facing web and mobile apps that run on the same API and admin system as your back office.

## For law firms
- [For law firms](https://trustedtechleader.com/law-firms/): the six-stage lead system for immigration, personal injury and family law firms
- [For travel businesses](https://trustedtechleader.com/travel/): inquiry-to-booking and trip operations systems for tour operators, group travel organisers and travel clubs
- [For real estate investors](https://trustedtechleader.com/real-estate/): paced direct-mail outreach and a deal pipeline from reply to closing for land investors and wholesalers
- [AI visibility diagnostic](https://trustedtechleader.com/ai-visibility/): what AI assistants say when a client asks for a firm like yours, and what to fix
- [Free AI Visibility Scan](https://trustedtechleader.com/free-scan/): request a free scan across four AI assistants
- [Free AI audit](https://trustedtechleader.com/ai-audit/): six-question self-audit of law-firm intake

## Case studies
- [All case studies](https://trustedtechleader.com/case-studies/): custom business systems described from the code (travel membership, real estate, pharmacy, facilities, food service), plus AI automation, mobile apps, legal and WordPress SEO case studies. No invented metrics; no client named without permission.
